notes: phucbm.com is a personal portfolio (Phuc Bui, frontend engineer). sitemap-0.xml lists only /, /about, /resume, /work; llms.txt confirms only those 4 pages. /components redirects (302) to /404 and does not exist. The item template https://phucbm.com/r/{name}.json returns 404 for every probed component name (button, badge, card, marquee, text-scramble). No shadcn registry present.

DNS resolves (pure.kam-ui.com -> 76.13.241.28) but the host does not accept connections. Retried multiple times with 40-55s timeouts; TCP connect never completes on port 443 or 80 (curl code 000, connect time 0; nc -z fails on both ports). Parent domain kam-ui.com is also unreachable. Host is down/unreachable.
